selected_script.angle: Absurd scuba grandpa rescues kitchen from sliding broom clutter
selected_script.hook: Close-up of a broom sliding down a tiled kitchen corner wall, knocking over a dustpan onto the floor

timeline: 0-1.5s: Close-up of a broom sliding down a kitchen wall and falling.
1.5-3s: An absurd grandpa in full scuba gear enters carrying the Command Broom Gripper.
3-6s: The broom handle is pushed into the Command Broom Gripper on the wall, securing it.
6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the broom hanging neatly off the floor.
0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 showing a mop hanging securely in a clean laundry room.
4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing a wet swiffer hanging perfectly off the floor in a pantry.
8-10s: CTA reading 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.'
